text:
ellen_se: FYI — BetaCorp vendor risk sent a SIG/CAIQ follow-up asking for our BCP/DR details: RTO/RPO targets, backup cadence & retention, failover behavior (AZ vs region), SLA specifics, and whether we perform DR tests. They need it by COB.

ash_sales: Can someone give a short, customer-ready blob I can paste into their CAIQ response? @maria_security @drew_engineer

maria_security: Paste-ready answer: 
- RTO targets: `Control plane` ~1 hour; `Automated data-plane failover` target ~15 minutes (typical).
- RPO targets: `< 15 minutes` for standard hosted; stricter RPOs available via Dedicated with cross-region replication.
- Backups: nightly full backups + incremental snapshots every 6 hours; default retention 30 days. Backups are encrypted at rest using KMS (customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private).
- Failover: automated AZ failover with health checks; optional warm-standby cross-region failover for enterprise plans.
- DR testing: semi-annual tabletop + failover drills; test summaries and runbook extracts provided under NDA.
- SLA: Hosted API baseline `99.9%` monthly uptime; Dedicated `99.95%` (contractual). Credits and historical uptime reports available under NDA.

Feel free to trim for the CAIQ cell.

drew_engineer: Small technical caveat to include if they press: prefix/KV caches are best-effort and not part of the authoritative replication. Authoritative state is in replicated storage + WAL/incremental snapshots. For customers needing sub-15m RPO we recommend Dedicated with continuous WAL shipping + warm-standby region — we've validated <5m RPO in POCs.

aj_ops: Runbook/run-through summary you can add: we have automated detection + alerting -> control-plane escalation -> automated routing rules switch traffic to standby -> data integrity verification -> rollback plan. Example snippet we hand out after NDA:
`- detect -> escalate -> failover -> verify -> postmortem`

ops-bot: Uploaded `sig_caic_bcp_v2.pdf` and `dr_runbook_extract.pdf` to the thread (restricted access).

ash_sales: Great — I'll send this. If BetaCorp asks for SLA math, say we can provide 30/90/365 day uptime windows and service-level credit calculations under NDA. Also note longer backup retention and on-prem export are available on contract.

maria_security: Also add: access to backups and runbook artifacts is audited and role-restricted; we support customer-managed KMS for encryption key custody in Dedicated/Private deployments.

ellen_se: Perfect — thanks everyone. Sending the CAIQ response now. :rocket:
